about_the_game:
Dependency Psychological Test is a narrative-driven point-and-click game that blends everyday storytelling with interactive psychological testing. Rooted in the field of psychometrics, the game invites players to explore the concept of dependency through branching dialogue, subtle choices, and relationship-building.

In a cozy, life-like setting, you'll interact with family members, friends, and neighbors. Through meaningful conversations and small yet impactful decisions, you’ll uncover how you respond to emotional, social, and practical challenges—on your own, or by relying on others.

Do you trust yourself, or do you seek help when things get tough? Your choices shape not only the story but also your personal psychological report at the end of the game, offering insights into your dependence levels and self-confidence.

Whether you’re a fan of introspective games, narrative exploration, or simply curious about yourself, Dependency Psychological Test offers a calm, reflective gameplay experience with multiple outcomes based on how you engage with the world.
